svg.title: Indian Ocean South Equatorial Countercurrent: OSW editorial reference-route candidate
svg.desc: Equirectangular schematic. Approximately 4400 km. Declared 50-90 E eastward winter surface reach. The 50 E start is an OSW offshore truncation beyond the western confluence, and 90 E follows approximate recirculation context. Neither is a diagnosed whole-current terminus. Excludes Somali/East African source legs, the southern return into SEC, South Java continuation, equatorial Wyrtki jets and subsurface SEUC. Source describes regional geography; OSW selects the drawn route. No measured current axis.
svg.text: OSW approximate December-March surface studied reach — candidate
Dashed: nominal route · pale: 27 editorial scenarios
Not an observed axis or statistical confidence interval
Source: Wu et al. (2020), sec. 2-3; OSW selects vertices
Equirectangular OSW atlas ground · scientific review pending
